permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation. Nothing contained herein shall make an inspection time unreasonable during an emergency.

generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in the fuel shall be considered a change in the method of operation of the data processing center and may require a new or amended permit.
generatorSets.controlTechnology: turbocharged engine and aftercooler/charge air cooler
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The engine-generator sets (Ref. Nos. EG01 – EG15 and EG-2-01 through EG-2-31) shall only be operated in the following modes: In situations that arise from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where the primary energy or power source is disrupted or disconnected due to conditions beyond the control of an owner or operator of a facility; For participation in an ISO-declared emergency; For periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: not less than once each day the engine-generator set is operated
